confirmClaim.source: Remove this claim and its recorded assessment? Your original passage, other claims and themes will be kept.
confirmClaim.text: 移除此论断及其已记录的评估？原始段落、其他论断和主题将保留。

claimRemoved.source: Claim removed. Your passage, other claims and themes were kept.
claimRemoved.text: 已移除此论断。原始段落、其他论断和主题均已保留。

confirmTheme.source: Remove this theme, its notes and its statements? Other themes, claims and retained source reports will be kept.
confirmTheme.text: 移除此主题及其笔记和句子？其他主题、论断和已保留的来源报告将保留。

themeRemoved.source: Theme removed. Other themes, claims and retained source reports were kept.
themeRemoved.text: 已移除此主题。其他主题、论断和已保留的来源报告均已保留。

clearRefused.source: Clear recovery could not be prepared. Your draft was kept. Download its private JSON before trying again.
clearRefused.text: 无法准备清空恢复。你的草稿保持不变。重试前请下载其私密 JSON。

clearRestored.source: Cleared draft restored in this tab with its original paper versions and unfinished edits. Your saved library is unchanged.
clearRestored.text: 已在此标签页恢复清空的草稿，包括原论文版本和未完成的编辑。已保存的文献库保持不变。

confirmClear.source: Clear this tab's draft, including unfinished edits and unimported report text? You can undo here before editing, importing or restoring other work, or closing or reloading this tab.
confirmClear.text: 清空此标签页的草稿，包括未完成的编辑和未导入的报告文本？在编辑、导入或恢复其他内容，或关闭、重新加载此标签页之前，你可以在此撤销。

removalRefused.source: Removal recovery could not be prepared. Your draft was kept. Download its private JSON before trying again.
removalRefused.text: 无法准备移除恢复。你的草稿保持不变。重试前请下载其私密 JSON。

removalRestored.source: Removed draft content restored in this tab with its original source versions, assessments and unfinished edits.
removalRestored.text: 已在此标签页恢复被移除的草稿内容，包括原始来源版本、评估和未完成的编辑。

undoClearGuidance.source: Recovery is available only in this tab until you edit, import or restore other work, or close or reload it. Your saved library is unchanged.
undoClearGuidance.text: 恢复仅在此标签页可用，直到你编辑、导入或恢复其他内容，或关闭、重新加载该标签页。已保存的文献库保持不变。
